title: Monte Carlo simulation of PIPS Ising model
description: Intermediate step that runs the full Monte Carlo simulation with time-dependent quench to produce spin configurations for domain size analysis.

title: Domain size analysis and trend verification
description: Scored artifact containing domain size measures (FZC, k1) for four simulation conditions, to be checked against the paper’s qualitative ordering trends.
output_schema: CSV with columns: condition_id (string, one of 'k01_T04','k1_T04','k01_T03'), k (float), T_q (float, in units of a), MCS_at_fixed_degree (int), FZC_mean (float), k1_mean (float).
